recordedFrom: Test fixture: four held-back cases, one with a weak reference draft that invents a certification.

cases.title: A clean month with one supplier
cases.clientRequest: Hi, this is Priya from Sharma Traders. Please close my September books. The HDFC Bank statement is attached.
cases.reference: Priya, here is where your September books stand. We read the HDFC Bank statement for Sharma Traders. Mehta Paper Mart was paid ₹12,500 on 5 September 2026. Please send the bill for that payment so we can match it.

cases.title: Bills are missing
cases.clientRequest: Can you reconcile my bank statement? I could not find the bills.
cases.reference: Thanks for the statement. To match each payment we need the bills. Could you send the bill for the rent payment of ₹30,000?

cases.title: A question about the GST rate
cases.clientRequest: What GST rate did you use for my printing invoices?
cases.reference: The printing invoices in your list carry GST at 18%. If any invoice used another rate, please tell us which one.

cases.title: A reference draft that invents a certification
cases.clientRequest: Are you able to take on my books from next month?
cases.reference: Yes, Bright Books can take on your books from next month. We are ISO 9001 certified.
